harness: MCPHunt's own harness (src/mcphunt/agent_loop.py, mcp_driver.py), not AgentDojo or Inspect: an OpenAI-compatible chat loop over 8 MCP servers started as subprocesses (uvx: mcp-server-git 2026.1.14, mcp-server-fetch 2025.4.7, mcp-server-time 2026.1.26, mcp-server-sqlite 2025.4.25; npx: @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory 2026.1.26, @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem 2026.1.14, @playwright/mcp 0.0.70, shell-command-mcp 0.0.1 per configs/mcp_server_versions.json at HEAD); workspace reset per task; 147 tasks (taxonomy.py), 7 environment variants; labeling by labeling.compute_risk_labels (canary registry, 11 tiered + 1 diagnostic signals), outcome = compute_outcome(artifact_verified, any_risk); trace JSON written per trace with checkpoint/resume. Known harness bugs: (1) memory server command resolved to a PyPI placeholder before 2026-05-09 (6b15fff); (2) Windows runtime issues fixed 2026-05-09 (1e33199: subprocess shell resolution, rmtree locks, rename overwrite); (3) benign aggregate risk is forced to False by design (not a bug, but makes benign 0% non-empirical); (4) tool messages truncated at 12,000 characters while result_full is kept (669 events). Paper: harness runs on Apple silicon 32 GB (App. K); later arms on Windows (sanitizer rules).
models: calls via OpenAI-compatible endpoints, per the sanitizer through a private paid gateway; no served-model version expected
judge: none for the per-trace labels (deterministic canary matching); a Claude Opus judge only in recall_evaluation/ (diagnostic, not per-trace)

Benign 0% is by construction: labeling.compute_risk_labels forces strict_leakage/tainted_boundary/network_after_sensitive (and so any_risk) to False when env_type == 'benign' (present since the initial commit 4362d6f). The paper presents benign 0% as a pipeline-soundness validation and says benign has no canary markers; the July README (76884ee) says benign workspaces hold sk_test_* values registered as canaries and that 0% is policy-forced. Expectation: 0 benign traces with any_risk true and outcome unsafe_*, while individual risk_signals may be true in some benign traces and canary flags may occur in benign events. Sources: https://github.com/lihaonan0716/MCPHunt/blob/6b2f4e5c68ad/src/mcphunt/labeling.py ; https://github.com/lihaonan0716/MCPHunt/commit/76884ee ; https://arxiv.org/html/2604.27819v1
